source_findings.postread_axis: additive M2213 group-major B4 LRU4; every hit enters ST_FETCH_REQ and completes 12 accepted eight-bank request/response beats before ST_BRIDGE
source_findings.preread_axis: frozen M2018 SCHEDULE_MODE=1 group-major B4; a resident hit suppresses the SRAM fetch
source_findings.postread_payload_policy: returned payload writes are guarded by !postread_hit_q; hit responses are identity-validated and counted but discarded while the resident cache row is retained
source_findings.exact_scoreboards: all three axes check Acc24 lanes plus context/tag/slice/terminal, unique commits, products, requests and per-bank responses
source_findings.causal_identity_required: postread scalar bank requests minus preread scalar bank requests equals the observed postread-hit bank accepts

reviewer_notes: The ordinary axis is intentionally token-major, whereas post-read and pre-read are the matched group-major pair; B4 denotes four contexts and is common to all axes.
M2213 post-read-only observability counters are additive hardware, so this review cannot authorize an area or throughput-per-area comparison.
The future directed counts remain assertions until M2215 passes and M2216 independently seals the raw result.
